title: Minimum Wages Order 2024 (RM1,700 national monthly minimum wage)
issuing_institution: Government of Malaysia / National Wages Consultative Council
publication_date: 2024 (in force 1 February 2025; small-employer exemption ended August 2025)
location_in_source: Gazetted order; rate applies uniformly to all states including Sabah, Sarawak and Labuan
population_scope: All private-sector employees including foreign workers
definition_used: Basic monthly wage floor, excluding allowances, bonuses, commissions and overtime
limitations: Applies to the private sector; it is not a public-sector pay reference. Verified through multiple secondary compliance publications rather than by retrieving the gazette itself - the gazette should be cited directly in a formal submission.

title: Sistem Saraan Perkhidmatan Awam (SSPA) salary schedules - Pekeliling Perkhidmatan Bilangan 1 Tahun 2024

definition_used: BASIC salary only. Excludes fixed allowances, employer pension/EPF contribution and departmental overheads

title: Federal Constitution of Malaysia — current legislation portal
definition_used: Constitutional allocation of powers, equality, religion, education, citizenship, finance and public-service functions
limitations: The portal is authoritative, but the legal application of each provision to the proposed instruments remains for AGC; this register records issues, not opinions or clearance

title: Citizenship services and constitutional application pathways
issuing_institution: National Registration Department / Ministry of Home Affairs
location_in_source: Applications under Articles 14, 15(1), 15(2), 15A, 16, 19 and 23

limitations: Confirms the responsible administrative routes but not the permissible MIB 2.0 service commitments, disclosure duties, decision reasons or review standards; AGC and KDN/JPN clearance required

title: Personal Data Protection Act 2010 [Act 709] and 2024 amendment materials
issuing_institution: Personal Data Protection Commissioner / Government of Malaysia
location_in_source: Act 709, section 3 application boundary; current Act and amendment pages

definition_used: Regulation of personal data processing in commercial transactions; section 3(1) excludes Federal and State Governments
limitations: Government exclusion does not establish the positive public-sector governance regime; private contractors and partners may still be within Act 709. Agency-specific and public-sector controls require separate identification

limitations: Does not by itself identify the correct vote, appropriation, grant instrument, procurement method or current delegated threshold for any programme
